name: israeli-tax-refund

display_description.he: מחשבון החזר מס לשכירים על בסיס טופס 106 וטופס 161. מזהה נקודות זיכוי שלא נוצלו, מחשב חבות מס אמיתית, ומנחה לגבי פיצויי פיטורים ופריסת מס.
display_description.en: Israeli tax refund calculator for salaried employees based on Form 106 and Form 161. Identifies unused credit points, calculates true tax liability, and guides on severance pay and tax spreading.

description: Israeli tax refund calculator for salaried employees based on Form 106 and Form 161. Use when user uploads Form 106 / 161 / 161a / 161d, asks "kama hechzar magiya li", "teum mas", "nikudot zikui", "madregot mas", "pitzuyim", "prisa shel mas", "retzef zchuyot", "retzef kitzba", or mentions life events: job change, maternity leave, "chofashat leida", military reserve duty "miluim", unemployment "avoda", termination "pitsurin", retirement "prisha", stock losses "hafsdim beShuk haHon", lump-sum bonuses, mortgage life insurance "bituach chayim al mashkanta", or Form 135/867. Do NOT use for business accounting or VAT (use a dedicated self-employed skill instead).
compatibility: No external APIs required. Works with Claude Code, Claude.ai, Cursor. PDF/image upload required for full form extraction.
